content:
olivia-sre: Hey all — quick followup from the postmortem (https://redwood/postmortems/2025-01-rollout-incident). We need to convert the remediation items into timeboxed tickets and owners. Main asks: auto-rollback criteria, blast-radius caps, canary gating telemetry. Who can own?

maria-eng: I can take auto-rollback criteria. Will draft a checklist. ETA: EOW next week?

liam-platform: I can own blast-radius caps and rollout policy changes. Quick proposal: default max% = 5% for platform-created flags, with per-team exceptions. Also tiered caps by env (dev/stage/prod).

olivia-sre: +1. For auto-rollback we need concrete metrics: error_rate, p95 latency, anomaly score. Maria, can you propose thresholds and a safe window?

maria-eng: Proposal (first pass): error_rate increase >0.4 percentage points vs baseline sustained 3m; p95 latency increase >30% sustained 5m; anomaly_score > 0.8 for 2 consecutive windows. Always require a 1-click human override.

devex-sarah: I'll own developer docs and a flag template. Will add examples for the three common languages and a CI check that validates rollback config exists.

product-joe: Need product approval on rollout % for experiments that affect billing or core flows. I'll coordinate and publish a short policy doc.

liam-platform: Implementation notes for blast-radius caps: add config fields -> global_max_percent, per_team_whitelist, region_limits. Default infra services to 0% until owners opt in. Enforce at flag-create API level.

olivia-sre: Also: canary sampling should be deterministic (user hashing + seed) so we can reproduce and rerun experiments. Add telemetry tag for canary cohort id.

deploy-bot: NOTE: staged deploys now support an 'autoRollback' stanza. Example config:
```
deploy:
  canary_percent: 5
  autoRollback:
    enabled: true
    metrics:
      - name: error_rate
        threshold: 0.004
        window: 180
```

maria-eng: I'll open an RFC for the auto-rollback flow — include runbook, alert thresholds, and a test harness. Owner: maria-eng. Target completion: 2025-01-12.

liam-platform: I'll add platform enforcement to the flag creation flow so accidental 100% feature flags are rejected unless explicitly allowed. Owner: liam-platform. ETA: 2025-01-19.

olivia-sre: Action summary for tracking board:
- Auto-rollback RFC and runbook (owner: maria-eng, due: 2025-01-12)
- Blast-radius defaults + per-team whitelist (owner: liam-platform, due: 2025-01-19)
- Flag templates + docs + CI check (owner: devex-sarah, due: 2025-01-10)
- Synthetic rollback smoke test (owner: maria-eng + devex-sarah, due: 2025-01-15)
- Product policy on rollout % (owner: product-joe, due: 2025-01-09)
- 2-week postmortem follow-up sync (owner: olivia-sre)

devex-sarah: Can we add a simple smoke test that verifies the rollback path end-to-end? I can pair with Maria for the harness.

maria-eng: Yes — plan: harness triggers a synthetic error and asserts deploy-bot pauses and then rolls back automatically. We'll add as a nightly integration.

olivia-sre: I'll create the tracking board and schedule a 30m sync next Tue 10am PT. @product-joe please invite relevant PMs and data infra. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

liam-platform: Quick ask — can we also add a dashboard card that shows "active rollouts > configured cap" and recent auto-rollbacks in the console? That will help visibility.

olivia-sre: Good idea. Adding to the board (visibility/dashboard task).

product-joe: Thanks — I'll flag stakeholders and include this in the next weekly PM sync.

olivia-sre: Closing thread for now. Ping me if anything slips.
